title: Aoseki wins Nagoya sumo tournament and returns to ōzeki rank
summary: In an exciting three-way playoff, Aoseki triumphed on the final day of the tournament and fulfilled his promise to return to the second-highest rank.

title: Car rams into Berlin Pride parade, killing one and injuring sixteen
summary: The attack, which occurred near the Pride march, is being investigated for possible links with the Islamic State.

title: 10 years since Yamayurien disability center attack, marked with floral tributes
summary: Relatives and citizens gathered at the site of the 2016 mass attack to remember the victims and call for a more inclusive society.

title: UNESCO declares Asuka and Fujiwara archaeological sites World Heritage
summary: The designation includes the Kitora and Takamatsuzuka tombs and other remains of Japan's ancient capital.

title: Yokohama High School wins Kanagawa tournament, qualifies for summer Koshien for 22nd time
summary: With a decisive 11-1 victory over Kogakuin University High, Yokohama secured its ticket to the national baseball championship.

title: Takadai Koryo High School returns to summer Koshien after 24 years with win over Sen-da Matsudo
summary: A three-run home run in the ninth inning decided the game and gave Takadai Koryo the Chiba tournament title.

title: Unagi Day boosts demand for eel in Japan amid abundant catches and high costs
summary: Despite good catches of young eels, restaurants maintain previous prices due to increased costs from tensions in the Middle East.

title: Hanasaki Tokuharu High School wins Saitama tournament, qualifies for summer Koshien for ninth time
summary: In a close game, Hanasaki Tokuharu came from behind in the later innings to defeat Urawa Gakuin.

title: Nitta High School from Ehime qualifies for summer Koshien for second time in five years
summary: Nitta defeated Matsuyama Gakuin 12-3 to secure its place in the national baseball tournament.

title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto reaches 100 combined wins between Japan and Major League Baseball
summary: The Dodgers' Japanese pitcher earned his 11th win of the MLB season to complete the century.

title: Yu Yamada wins bronze medal in men's épée at Fencing World Championships
summary: For the second consecutive year, Yamada won the bronze medal in the individual épée event.

title: Massive forest fires in France and Spain force evacuation of over 300,000 people
summary: A firefighter died and flames advance towards Bordeaux as a heatwave worsens the situation.

title: 56-year-old father dies after being swept away by rip current at Ibaraki beach
summary: Three members of the same family were swept away by the current in Kashima; the father died and the children were rescued.

title: Torrential rains flood central Niigata, trigger level 4 alerts in northern Japan
summary: Authorities issued warnings of flood and landslide hazards in several regions of Hokuriku and Tohoku.

title: Osaka Liberal Democratic Party pushes for creation of a second capital for Japan
summary: The initiative seeks to decentralize government by designating Osaka as the second capital, amid the passage of a law in the Diet.

title: 19-year-old Rena Kato wins first professional golf tournament at Daitokentaku II Heya Net Ladies
summary: Kato finished at 22 under par, surpassing her rivals on the Japanese tour.

title: Ishin party expels Hyogo lawmaker Takashi Kado over unauthorized rental of campaign vehicles
summary: Kado violated party rules by operating a campaign car rental business without permission.

title: Japan rallies against Philippines, advances to quarterfinals at Women's Lacrosse World Cup
summary: With two consecutive wins, the Japanese national team secured a spot in the next round of the world championship.

title: Two lightning incidents disrupt train and power in Tokyo with no serious injuries
summary: A Keiō Inokashira line train stopped due to a lightning-caused breakdown and a light pole emitted sparks in Setagaya.

title: US halts attacks against Iran as Iran boasts of secret missile facilities
summary: Trump ordered a halt to new military offensives against Iran, while Tehran claims to have missile production centers unknown to Washington.
